label: D1 after a1->S2 unrewarded, larger if trial before was unrewarded a1, smaller if S2 rewarded
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * isin((tv("action", -2) * 100 + tv("state", -2) * 10 + tv("reward", -2)), [120, 110]) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * isin((tv("action", -2) * 100 + tv("state", -2) * 10 + tv("reward", -2)), [121, 211]) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * ((tv("action", -2) * 100 + tv("state", -2) * 10 + tv("reward", -2)) == 220) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 r")
explanation: Active only at D1 (zero at GO/D2). Magnitude is driven almost entirely by the previous trial being a1 -> S2 (rare) unrewarded (dev weight ~0.48; this term alone gives R^2 beyond timing 0.37). Within those trials it is higher when the trial before was also an unrewarded a1 trial (a1 S2 u or a1 S1 u, +0.31), and lower when the trial before gave evidence for S2 being good (a1 S2 r or a2 S1 r, -0.50; a2 S2 u slightly lower, -0.15). After a1 S2 r it is barely raised. The ideal-observer belief (belief_lo, belief thresholds, belief_cover) adds essentially nothing (<0.01) beyond these history terms, and counting earlier a1 choices adds little. Test R^2 beyond timing 0.39 (dev 0.41), roughly the all-observed reference (0.41); the all ceiling including the model policy is 0.47, so losing the value/policy terms costs about 0.06-0.08. The rest is a bimodal split among a1 S2 u trials (about 0 vs about 1.6) that observed history does not separate; the earlier policy-based label points to the agent leaning toward repeating a1.
